items.item: DDU Digital Design Unit, TU Darmstadt

Computes PCA orientation for input geometry. 3D meshes and breps use face-area-weighted sampling before PCA; extrusions use a 2D minimum bounding rectangle. Returns OBB, aligned geometry, translation vector, and PCA transformation matrix.
